answer:
Vitest + jsdom already covers mount, effects, refs, hydration and streaming; the harness needs only small helpers.
Evidence: this session's scratch probes and packages/ui/src/__tests__/hydrate.test.ts run `mount`/`hydrateMount` in `@vitest-environment jsdom` with React's `act`, `IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT`, a per-test `dispose`, and a `tick` to wait for async runs.
Helpers worth shipping: a `render(app, { layer })` that sets act mode, wraps mount in act and registers disposal in afterEach; `flush()` that awaits pending re-runs and post-commit effects; a mock-Layer helper. Everything else is plain DOM, so Testing Library queries can sit on top.
